**Considering team composition**

I need to select three Pokémon for my team. Primarina could serve well against threats like Dragapult and Rotom with Energy Ball, but it's vulnerable to Gholdengo and Aegislash. Incineroar can pivot and intimidate while also burning physical attackers, which might give it an edge against Aegislash and Gholdengo. Gliscor might set up hazards and has Earthquake, but I have to consider its Levitate targets. Kingambit could be a strong endgame choice, especially against Ditto. 

I think Primarina, Incineroar, and Kingambit could form a well-rounded team!**Choosing my team strategy**

I need to bring Gliscor for setting up rocks and providing electric resistance, but I have to keep in mind that Rotom could use Hydro Pump. Primarina might deal with Rotom nicely using Energy Ball. Incineroar will handle threats like Aegislash and Gholdengo while pivoting effectively. Kingambit will be good against ghost types. I won’t have any hazard removal, but that’s manageable. I’m thinking I should lead with Primarina and bring along Incineroar and Kingambit for a solid team!
